comment: pager.c add_cmap_descr() 1150-1161: a Tourist uses the / command's 'something else (by symbol or name)' choice and types the symbol '}'. do_screen_description() describes each matching map symbol with no glyph, so the S_pool and S_water entries, both explained as 'water', are renamed 'pool of water' and 'wall of water' (off the Plane of Water).
